title: SAP PM Consultant
summary: Sets up and supports the Plant Maintenance (also called Enterprise Asset Management) part of SAP so that plants can record their machines, plan preventive work and run repair orders. Sits in an SAP project or support team next to the materials and finance consultants, working with maintenance planners and engineers.
dailyDuties: Run fit-gap workshops with maintenance planners and engineers
Configure equipment, functional locations, task lists and maintenance plans
Set up notification and order types and their links to MM and CO
Prepare and load asset master data during cutover
Write test scripts and run integration and user testing
Train planners and resolve PM support tickets

skills.expectation: Configure equipment, functional locations, task lists, maintenance plans and order types
Run the maintenance cycle end to end: notifications, orders, confirmations and history
Run fit-gap workshops with maintenance teams and write functional specs
Map preventive, breakdown and corrective maintenance processes
Load equipment, functional locations and maintenance plans during cutover
Write test scripts and run integration and user acceptance testing
Train planners and technicians and explain design choices
Work with plant maintenance, stores and finance teams
Handle spare parts, reservations and external services from MM
Set up order costing and settlement with CO
Understand preventive, predictive and breakdown strategies on the shop floor
Report MTTR, MTBF and downtime from maintenance history
Write specs ABAP developers can build reports and enhancements from
Resolve PM support tickets within SLA after go-live

certifications.why: Covers the MM side of spares and service procurement
